notes.title: Gameplay Improvements
notes.content:
1.Adjusted the basic hit sound effect.

2.Normal attacks can now be performed while moving.

3.Added contact splash effect.

4.Added audio compressor.

5.Changed the configuration file path.

6.Changed the save file path.

notes.title: Issue with the position of the Element Disc
notes.content: Fixed the issue with the position of the Element Disc

notes.title: Issue of UI font being too small at high resolutions
notes.content: Fixed the issue where the UI font appeared too small in windowed mode with high resolutions (the actual issue was that the entire UI was too small).

notes.title: Added a mini-map and some necessary prompts
notes.content:
1.Unified the terms "Library" and "Bookstore."
2.When enemies are present within a certain range, attack skills can no longer trigger dialogues.
3.Added a prompt to guide new players to save points.
4.Added a mini-map.
5.Fixed the issue where the greyed-out dialogue button could be triggered by a key press.
6.Various other issues.
